items.name: TCP accept on port (default 6379) / bind address
items.why: Listening socket (anetTcpServer, redis.c:1552) accepts clients; enforces maxclients; each client gets readQueryFromClient.

items.name: replication stream from the master (when slave)
items.why: After SYNC the master link becomes a client flagged REDIS_MASTER; its writes run through the same cmdTable.

items.name: [/path/to/redis.conf]
items.why: Single optional positional argument; more than one prints usage and exits; without it defaults are used.

items.name: timeout
items.why: Config directive: idle client timeout in seconds (0 disables).

items.name: port
items.why: Config directive: TCP listen port.

items.name: bind
items.why: Config directive: listen address.

items.name: save
items.why: Config directive: save point <seconds> <changes> triggering a background save.

items.name: dir
items.why: Config directive: chdir to the working directory holding dump, AOF and temp files.

items.name: loglevel
items.why: Config directive: log verbosity.

items.name: logfile
items.why: Config directive: log file path or stdout.

items.name: databases
items.why: Config directive: number of databases (server.dbnum).

items.name: maxclients
items.why: Config directive: maximum simultaneous clients.

items.name: maxmemory
items.why: Config directive: memory limit; DENYOOM commands are refused above it.

items.name: slaveof
items.why: Config directive: start as a slave of <masterip> <masterport>.

items.name: masterauth
items.why: Config directive: password sent with AUTH to the master.

items.name: glueoutputbuf
items.why: Config directive: glue small reply buffers before writing (yes/no).

items.name: shareobjects
items.why: Config directive: share equal string objects (yes/no).

items.name: rdbcompression
items.why: Config directive: LZF-compress strings in dump.rdb (yes/no).

items.name: shareobjectspoolsize
items.why: Config directive: size of the object sharing pool.

items.name: daemonize
items.why: Config directive: fork into the background and write the pid file (yes/no).

items.name: appendonly
items.why: Config directive: enable the append-only file (yes/no).

items.name: appendfsync
items.why: Config directive: AOF fsync policy.

items.name: requirepass
items.why: Config directive: password clients must send with AUTH.

items.name: pidfile
items.why: Config directive: pid file path used when daemonized.

items.name: dbfilename
items.why: Config directive: snapshot file name.

items.name: vm-enabled
items.why: Config directive: enable virtual-memory swapping (yes/no).

items.name: vm-swap-file
items.why: Config directive: swap file path (%p expands to the pid).

items.name: vm-max-memory
items.why: Config directive: memory above which values are swapped out.

items.name: vm-page-size
items.why: Config directive: swap page size in bytes.

items.name: vm-pages
items.why: Config directive: number of swap pages.

items.name: vm-max-threads
items.why: Config directive: maximum VM I/O threads (0 = blocking VM).

items.name: hash-max-zipmap-entries
items.why: Config directive: hash size limit for zipmap encoding.

items.name: hash-max-zipmap-value
items.why: Config directive: hash value length limit for zipmap encoding.

items.name: serverCron
items.why: 1-second time event: save points, key expiry, idle timeouts, child reaping, VM swap-out, master reconnect.

items.name: background save child (BGSAVE)
items.why: fork(); the child writes the snapshot with rdbSave and exits; started by BGSAVE, SYNC and save points.

items.name: background AOF rewrite child (BGREWRITEAOF)
items.why: fork(); the child rewrites the AOF into a temp file while the parent buffers the diff.

items.name: VM I/O threads
items.why: pthread_create in spawnIOThread (up to vm-max-threads) to load, size and write swapped values; only with vm-enabled.

items.name: VM completed-job pipe handler
items.why: Main-thread handler woken through a pipe by I/O threads to apply finished jobs.

items.name: beforeSleep
items.why: Runs before each event-loop wait; resumes clients whose swapped keys were loaded.

items.name: sendBulkToSlave
items.why: Writable handler that streams dump.rdb to a syncing slave after the BGSAVE finishes.

items.name: save-point check
items.why: Inside serverCron: starts rdbSaveBackground when a save <seconds> <changes> point is reached.

items.name: child reaping (wait3)
items.why: Inside serverCron: collects finished save/rewrite children and finalizes their files.

items.name: active key expiry
items.why: Inside serverCron: samples keys with an expire and deletes expired ones.

items.name: idle client and blocking-pop timeouts
items.why: Inside serverCron: closes idle clients and unblocks timed-out BLPOP/BRPOP.

items.name: VM swap-out
items.why: Inside serverCron: swaps values out while memory exceeds vm-max-memory.

items.name: master (re)connect
items.why: Inside serverCron: when replstate is REDIS_REPL_CONNECT, performs the blocking sync with the master.

items.name: segvHandler
items.why: SIGSEGV/SIGBUS/SIGFPE/SIGILL handler logging INFO and a backtrace (HAVE_BACKTRACE builds only).

items.name: master Redis server (slaveof host port)
items.why: anetTcpConnect to masterhost:masterport; sends AUTH (if masterauth) and SYNC, downloads the dump, keeps the link.

items.name: host name resolution for the master host
items.why: gethostbyname when masterhost is not a dotted IPv4 address; part of the master connection.

items.name: AUTH <masterauth> to the master
items.why: Sent over the master connection only when masterauth is set.

items.name: SYNC to the master
items.why: Requests the bulk dump from the master.

items.name: write propagation to slaves and MONITOR clients
items.why: Executed writes are queued to slaves/monitors over their inbound connections; no connection is opened.

items.name: keyspace: redisDb.dict
items.why: Per-database dict key -> robj; server.db[dbnum] in struct redisServer (redis.c:341), created at redis.c:1558.

items.name: dump.rdb
items.why: Default dbfilename: written via temp file + rename by rdbSave (redis.c:3256), loaded at startup by rdbLoad (redis.c:3618).

items.name: appendonly.aof
items.why: Append-only log of writes: opened redis.c:1580, written redis.c:7469, replayed redis.c:7528; name not configurable.

items.name: /tmp/redis-%p.vm
items.why: Default vm-swap-file for swapped-out values; opened and sized in vmInit (redis.c:7978) when vm-enabled.

items.name: expires dict (redisDb.expires)
items.why: Per-database key -> expire time; saved in the snapshot.

items.name: blocking keys (redisDb.blockingkeys)
items.why: Keys with clients blocked in BLPOP/BRPOP.

items.name: object sharing pool (server.sharingpool)
items.why: Pool of shared string objects used when shareobjects is on.

items.name: client, slave and monitor lists
items.why: server.clients, server.slaves and server.monitors connection registries.

items.name: /var/run/redis.pid
items.why: Default pidfile, written only when daemonized (redis.c:9117).

items.name: logfile (default stdout)
items.why: Log lines appended to the configured logfile, or stdout.

items.name: redis.conf (argv[1], or '-' for stdin)
items.why: Configuration file read once at startup.

items.name: temp-<pid>.rdb
items.why: Temporary snapshot renamed onto dbfilename; removed if the child dies.

items.name: temp-rewriteaof-bg-<pid>.aof
items.why: Rewritten AOF from the child; the parent appends its diff (backgroundRewriteDoneHandler, redis.c:1205) and renames it onto appendonly.aof (redis.c:1221).

items.name: temp-rewriteaof-<pid>.aof
items.why: Inner temp file of the rewrite, renamed to the bg temp name.

items.name: temp-<time>.<pid>.rdb (slave sync)
items.why: Dump received from the master, renamed onto dbfilename and loaded.

items.name: /proc/sys/vm/overcommit_memory
items.why: Read at startup on Linux to warn when overcommit is 0.

items.name: -h
items.why: server host, resolved with anetResolve; default 127.0.0.1.

items.name: -p
items.why: server port, default 6379.

items.name: -a
items.why: password; AUTH is sent only in interactive mode.

items.name: -r
items.why: repeat the command N times.

items.name: -n
items.why: database number, sent as SELECT before the command.

items.name: -i
items.why: force interactive mode.

items.name: <command> [arg ...]
items.why: Redis command word and arguments from argv or the '>> ' prompt, checked against the local cmdTable, then sent.

items.name: quit / exit
items.why: Typed at the interactive prompt; exits locally without contacting the server.

items.name: last argument from standard input
items.why: When exactly one argument is missing, stdin is read to EOF and used as the last argument.

notes: Components: the Makefile builds four programs (redis-server, redis-cli, redis-benchmark, redis-check-dump) and no library; shared objects (ae, anet, sds, adlist, zmalloc, lzf) are linked into several programs. utils/* scripts and Makefile targets are included with must=false only.
All 95 redis-server cmdTable entries plus QUIT (special-cased in processCommand) are must requests; the handler is the cmdTable function (smembers is served by sinterCommand).

redis-cli command words are listed as commands (kind client-command, must=false each); the single must item is '<command> [arg ...]'. The client table differs from the server: client-only zmerge, zmergeweighed, rewriteaof; server-only sync, zunion, zinter, zremrangebyrank; rpoplpush is bulk on the client but inline on the server.
redis-cli -a is only honoured in interactive mode: repl() sends AUTH (redis-cli.c:472-477); one-shot mode never sends it.
No environment variables are read by any C program (no getenv). Make variables (OPTIMIZATION, ARCH, PROF, CFLAGS, DEBUG) exist in the Makefile but are not listed.
When a config file is given, the three default save points (redis.c:1514-1516) are cleared first (redis.c:9129); only the file's save lines apply.
hash-max-zipmap-entries/value are parsed, but genRedisInfoString resets both to their compiled defaults each time INFO runs (redis.c:6486-6487).

Replication to slaves is master-side output over inbound connections (replicationFeedSlaves, sendBulkToSlave); only the slave side opens an outgoing connection (syncWithMaster). Listed as external must=false / worker must=false accordingly.
serverCron sub-steps are listed separately as cron-step workers with must=false; serverCron itself is the must timer.
VM (swap file, I/O threads) is off by default (vm-enabled no in redis.conf) but is a real code path; its swap file and threads are marked must.
The working tree also contains build outputs (*.o and the four binaries); they are untracked and git-ignored (.gitignore:2-8), not committed, and are not inventory items.
review_summary: Reviewer (read-only, code only): opened every must=true anchor (96 requests, 31 redis-server commands, 4 workers, 1 external, 4 data, 7 redis-cli commands + 1 external, 9->11 redis-benchmark flags + 1 external, 2 redis-check-dump items); all land on the named code with the right handler. Independent greps (cmdTable, loadServerConfig branches, fork/pthread_create/aeCreateTimeEvent/aeCreateFileEvent, fopen/open/rename, anetTcpConnect/anetTcpServer, getenv, argv parsing in the four mains) found no missing must item. All 37 original traps verified at their anchors. Edits were made in _gen/gen_redis.py and the JSON regenerated.

errata.reason: Consistency with the freqtrade and litestream flow marks: the program's own foreground loop belongs to the Main flow, not to workers. Redis keeps it as a trap (listing it as a worker is wrong); the other two inventories carry their loops as must=false workers items with flow=true.

errata.reason: The program's own foreground loop is scored against the Main flow, like freqtrade's Worker.run and litestream's restore follow loop (must=false workers items with flow=true), so the three repositories score their main loops alike. A workers row on it is an extra, not a trap hit.
